subject.title: [Feature]: Agent presentation tier: Control UI screen commands (splits/panels/sidebar) + agent terminal I/O

question: Should OpenClaw make agent-driven Control UI presentation and shared terminal sessions first-class core capabilities, and if so should terminal I/O be separated from the lower-risk screen-command phase?
rationale: The request changes both operator experience and an RCE-class execution boundary; source inspection can confirm the gap but cannot choose the intended trust and interaction model.

options.title: Sponsor screen commands first
options.body: Approve Phase A as a bounded capability-gated protocol/UI feature and require a separate security design review before agent terminal input.

options.title: Sponsor both phases
options.body: Approve the complete direction but require separate PRs and explicit security, ownership, reconnect, audit, and upgrade acceptance criteria for terminal I/O.

options.title: Keep operator-only control
options.body: Retain client-local presentation and operator-admin terminal ownership, declining agent-driven UI and PTY control as a core product boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor screen commands first
recommendation.body: Approve Phase A as a bounded capability-gated protocol/UI feature and require a separate security design review before agent terminal input.

likelyOwner.reason: This person proposed both this feature and its immediately preceding capability roadmap, making them the strongest available product-direction owner.
